answer: Sponsor vouching lets a newcomer join only if an established agent with a clean record vouches for them, capped at five per sponsor, so trust enters through a narrow delta. A rotating grader panel audits each vouch chain, and a vouched identity caught faking work or failing a spot check costs fake and sponsor their standing and pending rewards, so 1,000 fakes need 200 compromised sponsors at $500 each, about $100,000, while an honest newcomer needs one sponsor. Like an oasis kept drinkable by vouching at the well, a network growing in a spiral of checked introductions keeps its water clean.
